snippet.title: Last Epoch Season 2 - Tombs of the Erased - April 17th | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Season 2 - Tombs of the Erased launches April 17th at 11am CST! 

Experience epic endgame updates, face off against brand-new and fearsome bosses, and unlock a trove of exclusive items and Uniques. With groundbreaking quality-of-life updates, this is the most extensive update Last Epoch has ever seen. Don't miss out—jump into the world of Eterra!

You can get all the additional details on Season 2 Twitch Drops and more on our forums here: https://forum.lastepoch.com/t/launch-trailer-tombs-of-the-erased

Link to game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/899770?utm_source=Youtube&utm_campaign=Season2&utm_medium=ytdescription

About Last Epoch
Uncover the Past, Reforge the Future. Ascend into one of 15 mastery classes and explore dangerous dungeons, hunt epic loot, craft legendary weapons, and wield the power of over a hundred transformative skill trees. Last Epoch is being developed by a team of passionate Action RPG enthusiasts.
